description: Send text and get its sha256 or keccak256 hash as hex. Listed by Moonbeam and answered by the best-ranked seller behind it. 0.0012 USDC a call, paid with x402 on Base: without a payment the call answers the payment terms; send the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (or as `payment`, the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value) and call again.

payment.description: optional: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) for the terms the first call answered
